sloka: सुखा न: शर्वरी राजन् पूजिताश्चापि ते वयम् ।गङ्गां तु नौभिर्बह्वीभिर्दाशा: सन्तारयन्तु न: ।। २.८९.७ ।।
transliteration: sukhā na: śarvarī rājan pūjitāścāpi te vayam ।gaṅgāṁ tu naubhirbahvībhirdāśā: santārayantu na: ।। 2.89.7 ।।

translations.english: O king (Guha) the night passed comfortably for us. We have been honoured by you in many ways. Let your fishermen be ordered to ferry us across the Ganga in their boats.
translations.hindi: अतः हे लक्ष्मण ! मैं धनुष लेकर अपने प्रिय चन्द्र जी की, जो सीता संहित सो रहे ह ह वक साथ रक्षा करूंगा
